programs.name: p01_slab_bend_court
programs.rationale: A slab bent on x-axis 24 degrees (4 subdivisions) creates a curved C-arm in plan. Courtyard inscribed open east gives the public threshold. Slab 2.2×1.45×0.28 allows the bend arc to read continuously without closing the court.

programs.name: p02_bar_interlock_notch
programs.rationale: Two bar volumes interlock at their shared zone (axis x, bar_ratio 0.38), forming an L-shaped occupied body. Corner notch at east signals the address entry where the two arms meet the road.

programs.name: p03_tower_twist_carve
programs.rationale: Tower seed twisted 32 degrees on z-axis (4 subdivisions) produces a continuously rotating plan that resolves at ground as an east-facing carve void entry threshold.

programs.name: p04_slab_taper_branch_notch
programs.rationale: A slab tapered on z-axis (end_scale 0.62 at top) gives a pyramidal section. A book_branch at 0 degrees (arm_ratio 0.35) extends a compact eastward arm. Notch at east edge signals the entry without interrupting the taper.

programs.name: p05_bar_fracture_court
programs.rationale: A bar fractured at 22 degrees creates a wedge gap opening east. A courtyard at east follows as the public court bounded by the angled fracture face. The fracture's outward_sign pushes the break away from the road.

programs.name: p06_block_inflate_expand_notch
programs.rationale: A block inflated on z-axis produces a swollen crown section. boundary_expand on x-axis (+0.18) enlarges the east elevation. Notch at east signals the entry within the inflated facade.

programs.name: p07_bar_overlap_notch
programs.rationale: Two bar volumes partially overlap on y-axis (shift_ratio 0.38, slab_ratio 0.45) forming an H-plan as one connected solid. A notch at east signals the public entry between the overlapping bar ends at the street face.

programs.name: p08_slab_shear_book_notch
programs.rationale: A slab is sheared on z-axis in x-direction (amount 0.28) creating an oblique top face. book_notch at east face (ratio 0.28) inscribes the public entry into the shear-faced elevation.

programs.name: p09_bar_bend_branch_notch
programs.rationale: A bar is bent 20 degrees on x-axis; a book_branch at 90 degrees (arm_ratio 0.42) creates an L-plan. Notch at east signals the entry at the elbow junction where the bend meets the branch.

programs.name: p10_slab_profiled_hall_notch
programs.rationale: A slab receives a barrel profiled_hall spanning the y-axis giving a continuous barrel vault cross-section. Notch at east is the public entry reading as the low point of the vault against the street.

programs.name: p11_slab_split_wing_notch
programs.rationale: A slab split into two parallel wings along x-axis (gap_ratio 0.12, bridge=true) creates a double-bar plan with bridge spine. Notch at east marks the entry between the wings at the street.

programs.name: p12_tower_branch_branch_carve
programs.rationale: A tower receives two sequential branches: first at 90 degrees (arm_ratio 0.38) then at -90 degrees (arm_ratio 0.30), creating a T-plan. carve_void at east opens the base of the trunk as public court.
